title: Ice Release
body:
Ice Release forms from Water + Wind. Choose a second nature at level 25 after revealing your first at level 10; Dust Release additionally requires a third nature revealed at level 100. Clan Kekkei Genkai holders cannot gain an elemental release.

Techniques:
Level 25: Ice Senbon (help ice senbon)
Level 45: Ice Prison (help ice prison)
Level 70: Demonic Mirroring Ice Crystals (help demonic mirroring ice crystals)
